# BotFn

> Discord and Slack bot integrations, issue linking, persistence, and operator controls.

## Documentation

- [Administration capability](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/admin.md) — Integrate BotFn operator resources with Super Console.
- [Discord bot](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/discord-bot.md) — Configure signed interactions, issue commands, and the Worker.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Find the BotFn package or service that fits your integration.
- [BotFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Build and operate Discord and Slack bot integrations.
- [Integration helpers](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/integrations.md) — Reuse Discord, Slack, GitHub, Linear, and schema helpers.
- [Operations and limits](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/operations-and-limits.md) — Deployment responsibilities and current feature boundaries.
- [Persistence service](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/persistence.md) — Store issue and Discord thread relationships through tRPC.
- [Commands and routes](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/reference/commands-and-routes.md) — BotFn's registered commands, Worker routes, and tRPC procedures.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/reference/configuration.md) — Runtime bindings and deployment inputs by package.
- [Reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — BotFn package and runtime contract index.
- [Packages](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/reference/packages.md) — Current BotFn package map and public entry points.
- [Slack receiver](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/botfn/docs/content/docs/slack-bot.md) — Verify Slack requests and understand the current event handler.
